wizard.gaokaoPanelTitle: Gaokao routes: how to get there
wizard.gaokaoPanelIntro: No university publishes a Gaokao score → A-level grade conversion, so do not convert scores yourself. The Gaokao itself earns no UCAS Tariff points. The routes below are what each university officially publishes.
wizard.gaokaoUcl: UCL Computer Science BSc has no Gaokao direct-entry route. UCL's published routes for students from China are A-levels, IB, or one year of a bachelor's degree at a recognised Chinese university at 90%. The other route is the UCL Undergraduate Preparatory Certificate (UPC): UPCSE 70% overall with 76% in each core science unit maps to A*A*A for Computer Science. Apply direct to UCL (not via UCAS); the general deadline is 18 June 2027; entrance tests and an interview apply.
wizard.gaokaoImperial: Imperial College London does not accept the Gaokao for any degree, including Computing BEng. The official remedy is an accepted foundation programme or another accepted qualification; the page names no specific foundation provider.
wizard.gaokaoOthers: Other universities do accept the Gaokao for direct entry, but only as a flat total-score threshold — never as a conversion: Birmingham 80% overall (80% in Mathematics where required, plus the school graduation certificate at 85%); Sheffield 75% for AAA+ courses, 70% for AAB–ABB, 65% for BBB–BBC; Leeds 75–85% (plus Year 1–2 school average 80%); Southampton 80% / 75% / 70% by offer band (not for Engineering and Physical Sciences or medicine); York 75%; Cardiff Gaokao plus the school graduation certificate at 85%. Cambridge generally asks for a rank in the top 0.1% of Gaokao takers in the province — a rank, not a percentage — and colleges differ.
wizard.gaokaoAst: Gaokao + AST is a real route at some schools: LSE accepts Gaokao combined with AST (Aptitude Scholastic Test) scores — A = 210, A* = 250 per subject, and Mathematics A*/A requires 250 in Mathematics; the school diploma alone is not acceptable. Birmingham counts AST as A* = 250, A = 210, B = 170.
wizard.gaokaoTmua: Extra exams: TMUA (Test of Mathematics for University Admission) is required for Imperial Computing BEng and joint Maths/CS. China, Hong Kong and Macau test windows are 15–16 October 2026 and 8 January 2027. No published pass mark. No admissions test is required for UCL Computer Science BSc.
wizard.gaokaoUcas: UCAS deadlines for 2027 entry: 15 October 2026 for Oxford, Cambridge and most medicine, dentistry and veterinary courses; 13 January 2027 for most undergraduate courses, including UCL Computer Science BSc and Imperial Computing BEng. Maximum 5 choices.
wizard.gaokaoOxford: Oxford: whether it accepts the Gaokao is unknown — its international qualifications page could not be read in this check. Do not assume it is accepted or not accepted.
